z-accordion.summary: A group of collapsible sections with hairline dividers. Open one at a time or several.

type.description: How many sections may be open at once.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

keyboard.action: On a section header: opens or closes that section. In single mode, opening one closes the other.

z-accordion.accessibility: Each section is a z-collapsible: a native button that reports aria-expanded and controls a labelled region.

guidance.title: Children
guidance.text: Use direct z-collapsible children; the accordion supplies the shared border treatment and coordination.

guidance.title: Initial state
guidance.text: Set is-open on the child or children that should begin expanded.

guidance.title: Content density
guidance.text: Keep each answer concise. If the content needs its own page, link to it instead of hiding a full article here.

z-alert.summary: An inline status banner tinted by tone. It sits in the page flow and is not an overlay.

tone.description: Sets the color and icon of the alert. Use `danger` for failures, `warning` for risks, `success` for confirmations, and `primary` for news.

heading.description: Optional bold title shown above the message. Omit it for a compact one-line alert.

is-hidden.description: Hide (set automatically on dismiss).

dismiss.description: When the close button is clicked.

slots.heading: The heading, when you need more than the heading prop.
slots.actions: Buttons or links shown with the message.

keyboard.action: Reaches the dismiss button when the alert can be dismissed.
Dismiss the alert.

z-alert.accessibility: Renders with role="status", so a screen reader announces it politely. The dismiss control is a native button with a localised name.

guidance.title: heading and default slot
guidance.text: The heading summarizes the state; the default slot gives next steps or necessary detail.

guidance.title: Choice
guidance.text: Keep alerts near the affected content. Do not use them for an action that requires immediate confirmation.

z-alert-dialog.summary: A confirmation modal for destructive or consequential choices.

is-open.description: Whether the element is open. Reflected, so it can be set or read from markup or script.

heading.description: Title of the dialog. Phrase it as the question or decision being confirmed.

description.description: Body text that explains what will happen if the user confirms.

confirm-label.description: Text of the confirm button. Name the action, for example "Delete project", not "OK".

tone.description: Color of the confirm button. Use `danger` for destructive actions.

confirm.description: Fired when the confirm button is pressed.

cancel.description: Fired when the dialog is cancelled, by the cancel button or Escape.

slots.trigger: The element that opens the dialog.

keyboard.action: On the trigger: opens it and moves focus inside.
Cycles inside the dialog. The page behind is inert.
Cancels, closes it, and returns focus to the trigger.

z-alert-dialog.accessibility: role="alertdialog", labelled by its heading and described by its description. Focus moves inside when it opens and returns to the trigger when it closes.

z-avatar.summary: A circular identity mark. Shows an image and falls back to initials.

src.description: Image URL (falls back to initials on error).

name.description: Used for the alt text and initials.

initials.description: Initials to show when there is no image.

status.description: Presence dot in the bottom corner. Omit it to hide the dot.

size.description: Diameter of the avatar.

tone.description: Tint behind the initials fallback.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

z-avatar.accessibility: With a name it is exposed as an image labelled by that name; an image gets alt text from it, and initials stand in when the image fails to load. The status dot is hidden from assistive technology, so say the status in text nearby if it matters.

z-avatar-stack.summary: Overlaps avatars into one cluster and caps how many are shown.

max.description: Largest number of avatars to render. The rest collapse into a "+N" badge. `0` shows all of them.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

total.description: Overrides the overflow count when the full list is not in the DOM, for example when only the first few avatars are loaded.

size.description: Diameter of every avatar in the stack.

z-avatar-stack.accessibility: A visual cluster only. It adds no role, so name the people in nearby text when who is in the group matters.

z-badge.summary: A compact pill for status, metadata and tags.

tone.description: Color family of the badge. Use `danger`, `warning`, and `success` for status, `primary` and `secondary` for emphasis.

kind.description: Visual treatment. `soft` is a tinted fill, `solid` is a full fill, and `outline` is a border only.

size.description: Height and type size of the badge.

label.description: Text (alternative to slotting children).

value.description: Value carried in `select` / `remove` events.

is-dot.description: Inline status: leading dot + uppercase tracked text.

is-disabled.description: Blocks interaction, dims the element, and removes it from the keyboard focus order.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

remove.description: When the × on an `is-removable` badge is clicked.

slots.prefix: Content before the text, such as an icon or a dot.

keyboard.action: When selectable: toggles it. A removable badge has its own remove button.

z-badge.accessibility: Plain text by default. With is-selectable it becomes a focusable role="button" with aria-pressed. A removable badge adds a native remove button with a localised name.

z-bento-grid.summary: A grid with fixed row heights for bento cells.

columns.description: Defines the grid’s overall track system.

row-height.description: Defines the grid’s overall track system.

gap.description: Defines the grid’s overall track system.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

z-bento-grid.accessibility: Layout only. It adds no role or label and passes its content through unchanged.

guidance.title: Only accepts z-bento-item
guidance.text: Items supply spans, slots, and optional link behavior.

guidance.title: Use with restraint
guidance.text: It is for a finite capability story, not a general-purpose dashboard grid.

z-bento-item.summary: One cell of a bento grid, with an optional icon slot.

col-span.description: Number of columns the cell covers in its bento grid.

row-span.description: Number of rows the cell covers in its bento grid.

cta-label.description: Text of the call-to-action row. Only shown when `href` is set.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

href.description: Link target. Setting it reveals a call-to-action row on hover and focus. Omit it for a static cell.

slots.background: A layer behind the content, such as an image.

z-bento-item.accessibility: Layout and content. Its decorative layers are hidden from assistive technology.

z-box.summary: A layout box with spacing, sizing and alignment props. Flex by default, grid with display="grid".

does-wrap.description: Lets flex children wrap onto new lines (`flex-wrap: wrap`).

does-wrap-text.description: Lets text inside the box wrap instead of staying on one line.

gap.description: Space between children. Accepts a size keyword (2xs to 4xl), a scale step, or any CSS length.

direction.description: Lays children out in a row (`horizontal`) or a column (`vertical`).

display.description: `flex` (default) or `grid`. Grid reads `columns`, `rows` and the per-breakpoint column props.

aligns-x.description: Horizontal alignment of the children, whatever the flow direction.

aligns-y.description: Vertical alignment of the children, whatever the flow direction.

row-gap.description: Space between rows. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

column-gap.description: Space between columns. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

margin.description: Outer space on all sides. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

margin-top.description: Outer space on the top. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

margin-right.description: Outer space on the right. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

margin-bottom.description: Outer space on the bottom. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

margin-left.description: Outer space on the left. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

margin-x.description: Outer space on the left and right. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

margin-y.description: Outer space on the top and bottom. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

padding.description: Inner space on all sides. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

padding-top.description: Inner space on the top. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

padding-right.description: Inner space on the right. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

padding-bottom.description: Inner space on the bottom. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

padding-left.description: Inner space on the left. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

padding-x.description: Inner space on the left and right. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

padding-y.description: Inner space on the top and bottom. Accepts a scale step from 0 to 8 or any CSS length.

width.description: Width of the box. A bare number is treated as pixels. Any other CSS length is used as given.

min-width.description: Smallest width. A bare number is treated as pixels. Any other CSS length is used as given.

max-width.description: Largest width. A bare number is treated as pixels. Any other CSS length is used as given.

height.description: Height of the box. A bare number is treated as pixels. Any other CSS length is used as given.

min-height.description: Smallest height. A bare number is treated as pixels. Any other CSS length is used as given.

max-height.description: Largest height. A bare number is treated as pixels. Any other CSS length is used as given.

columns.description: Grid column template. A bare number `n` becomes `repeat(n, minmax(0, 1fr))`. Any other value is used as given.

rows.description: Grid row template. A bare number `n` becomes `repeat(n, minmax(0, 1fr))`. Any other value is used as given.

small-columns.description: Grid column template that replaces `columns` on small screens and up.

medium-columns.description: Grid column template that replaces `columns` on medium screens and up.

large-columns.description: Grid column template that replaces `columns` on large screens and up.

extra-large-columns.description: Grid column template that replaces `columns` on extra-large screens and up.

is-full-width.description: Fills the width of its container.

is-full-height.description: Fills the height of its container.

inset.description: Padding on all sides, from the spacing scale. Explicit padding props win.

inset-x.description: Left and right padding, from the spacing scale.

inset-y.description: Top and bottom padding, from the spacing scale.

z-box.accessibility: Layout only. It adds no role or label and passes its content through unchanged.

z-breadcrumbs.summary: A breadcrumb trail driven by an items array.

items.description: The trail, in order from root to current page. Set it as a property.

max.description: Collapse long trails to the first crumb + an ellipsis + the trailing `max - 1`.

tone.description: Accent color of links on hover and of the current page.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

navigate.description: When a crumb without an `href` is clicked.

keyboard.action: Moves through the links.
Follows the focused link.

z-breadcrumbs.accessibility: Renders links, and marks the current page with aria-current="page". A collapsed trail shows a native button that expands it.

z-button.summary: A button with kinds, tones and sizes. It can submit or reset a form.

size.description: Height and type size of the button.

kind.description: Visual treatment. Choose `kind` for priority first, then `tone` for meaning.

tone.description: Color family of the button.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

is-disabled.description: Blocks interaction, dims the element, and removes it from the keyboard focus order.

is-loading.description: Show a spinner and block interaction.

label.description: Text (alternative to slotting children).

type.description: Native button type. Use `submit` to submit the nearest form.

name.description: Form field name, used when the control is submitted with a form.

value.description: Value submitted with the form when this button is the submitter.

keyboard.action: Activates it. A submit button submits its form.

z-button.accessibility: A native button inside the shadow root, so it keeps native focus, Enter and Space behaviour and form participation. An icon-only button needs a name from its label or aria-label.

z-button-group.summary: Joins buttons into one segmented row.

is-vertical.description: Stack the buttons vertically (equal width) instead of in a row.

keyboard.action: Moves through the buttons in order.

z-button-group.accessibility: role="group" around its buttons. Give the group an aria-label when the buttons mean something together.

guidance.title: Use toggle group for modes
guidance.text: Button group executes separate commands; z-toggle-group represents one or more selected values.

guidance.title: Children
guidance.text: Use adjacent z-button elements with a consistent kind and size.

z-callout.summary: An in-flow note for documentation: a tip, a warning, or something important.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

tone.description: Type of note. Each kind has its own hue and icon.

heading.description: Optional title. Without it the callout renders compact, with the icon centered against the body.

is-expandable.description: Clamps the body to two lines with an inline "Show more" toggle. The toggle only appears when the text actually overflows.

is-expanded.description: Whether the clamped body is open. Reflected, so you can open it from markup or script.

keyboard.action: When it can expand: shows more or less.

z-callout.accessibility: role="note". The icon is hidden from assistive technology. Do not rely on tone alone: say what kind of note it is in its text.

z-card.summary: A bordered surface, optionally with a heading and description.

is-hidden.description: Hides the card with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

direction.description: Stacks children in a column (default) or lays them in a row.

is-reactive.description: Brighten the border on hover / focus-within.

heading.description: Title shown at the top of the card.

z-card.accessibility: A surface. The heading prop renders an h3, so keep heading levels in order on the page.

guidance.title: Use sparingly
guidance.text: Cards establish object boundaries. Prefer open layout for ordinary document sections.

z-carousel.summary: A slider that shows one child at a time.

autoplay.description: Ms between auto-advances (paused on hover/focus); omit to disable.

tone.description: Accent color of the controls and dots.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

change.description: Fired whenever the active slide changes. `index` is the zero-based position of the new slide.

slots.default: The slides. Each direct child is one slide.

keyboard.action: Reaches the previous and next buttons and the slide dots.
On a button or dot: moves to that slide.

z-carousel.accessibility: Previous, next and slide dots are native buttons with localised names, and the current dot has aria-current. Autoplay moves content on its own: leave it off unless there is a way to pause.

z-center.summary: Centers its content on both axes.

does-center-both.description: Force dead center on both axes.

max-width.description: Cap the inner content block (`xs`…`3xl`, `full`, `screen`, or any length).

does-center-text.description: Also centers text inside the content (`text-align: center`).

inset.description: Adds protective padding around the centered content.

inset-x.description: Padding on the left and right. Accepts a size keyword (2xs to 4xl), a scale step, or any CSS length.

inset-y.description: Padding on the top and bottom. Accepts a size keyword (2xs to 4xl), a scale step, or any CSS length.

is-full-width.description: Stretches to fill the parent's width.

is-full-height.description: Stretches to fill the parent's height.

z-center.accessibility: Layout only. It adds no role or label and passes its content through unchanged.

z-chassis.summary: A device-like application frame with a bezel and a rail.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

rail-width.description: Width of the rail when expanded. Any CSS length.

rail-collapsed-width.description: Width of the rail when collapsed. Only used with `does-expand-on-hover`.

bezel.description: Thickness of the outer body around the screen. Any CSS length.

frame.description: Corner radius and inset of the screen frame. Any CSS length.

does-expand-on-hover.description: Collapses the rail to a slim width and expands it while the pointer is over the rail.

slots.sidebar-header: Content at the top of the rail.
slots.sidebar-footer: Content at the bottom of the rail.

z-chassis.accessibility: A frame for an application layout. It adds no landmark roles, so put your own nav, main and header elements inside its slots.

z-checkbox.summary: A square checkbox that takes part in forms.

is-checked.description: Whether the box is checked. Reflected, so it can be set or read from markup or script.

is-indeterminate.description: Mixed state (visual; takes precedence over checked).

is-disabled.description: Blocks interaction, dims the element, and removes it from the keyboard focus order.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

size.description: Size of the box and its label.

tone.description: Accent color of the checked state.

name.description: Form field name, used when the control is submitted with a form.

value.description: Value submitted with the form when the box is checked.

label.description: Text shown beside the checkbox.

description.description: Helper text shown under the control and linked to it for screen readers.

error.description: Error message shown under the control. Setting it marks the control invalid.

is-required.description: Marks the field as required for form validation.

change.description: Fired when the box is toggled by the user.

keyboard.action: Toggles it.

z-checkbox.accessibility: A native checkbox with a visible label. It takes part in forms, reports validity, and follows a disabled fieldset. Description and error text are linked with aria-describedby.

z-code-block.summary: A syntax-highlighted code surface with an optional header and a copy button.

code.description: The source (set as a property to preserve whitespace).

language.description: Highlight.js language id (also shown in the header).

tone.description: Accent color of the language tag in the header.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

files.description: Files to show as tabs: [{ name, code, language? }]. Set it as a property.

is-flush.description: Removes the border, radius and background so the block sits flush in its container.

is-header-hidden.description: Hides the header row, including the filename, language and copy button.

added-lines.description: Lines to mark as added, written like "3-5,8".

removed-lines.description: Lines to mark as removed, written like "3-5,8".

focus-lines.description: Lines to keep in focus while the rest dim, written like "3-5,8".

copy.description: After the code is copied to the clipboard.

keyboard.action: Reaches the file tabs and the copy button.
On the copy button: copies the code.

z-code-block.accessibility: The copy control is a native button, and file tabs use role="tab" with aria-selected. Highlight colors are not the only carrier of meaning: the code is real text.

guidance.title: Bundle cost
guidance.text: Highlighting ships nine grammars (TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, SCSS, JSON, Bash, HTML/XML, YAML, Markdown). The element is about 139 kB (40 kB gzipped), far larger than any other. Import @tasteee/zest/z-code-block only where you show code. The root import includes it.

guidance.title: Unknown languages
guidance.text: A language outside that set renders as plain text, or is guessed from the code when the guess is confident.

z-collapsible.summary: A single disclosure section with a trigger row.

value.description: Identifier carried in the `toggle` event.

label.description: Trigger text (when not using the `trigger` slot).

tone.description: Accent color of the trigger when open.

is-open.description: Whether the element is open. Reflected, so it can be set or read from markup or script.

is-disabled.description: Blocks interaction, dims the element, and removes it from the keyboard focus order.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

toggle.description: Fired when the section opens or closes.

slots.trigger: A custom trigger, in place of the label prop.
slots.default: The content that opens and closes.

keyboard.action: On the trigger: opens or closes the section.

z-collapsible.accessibility: The trigger is a native button with aria-expanded, and the content is a region named by that trigger. A disabled section cannot be opened.

guidance.title: value and toggle
guidance.text: Give coordinated disclosures a value; toggle emits { value, open }.

z-color-picker.summary: A swatch that opens a panel for picking a color.

value.description: Current color as a hex string. Reflected.

presets.description: Swatches in the quick-pick row. Set it as a property.

tone.description: Accent color of the open state.

is-disabled.description: Blocks interaction, dims the element, and removes it from the keyboard focus order.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

label.description: Accessible name for the color picker.

name.description: Form field name, used when the control is submitted with a form.

change.description: Whenever the color changes (spectrum, hex field, or preset).

keyboard.action: On the swatch: opens the panel.
Closes the panel and returns focus to the swatch.

z-color-picker.accessibility: A native button with aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded, named by its label and current color. The panel is a labelled dialog, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the swatch.

z-column.summary: A vertical flex line with spacing and alignment.

gap.description: Token, CSS length, or number between children.

padding.description: Uniform spacing; individual inset props are supported too.

margin.description: Uniform spacing; individual inset props are supported too.

aligns-x.description: Cross- and main-axis alignment respectively in a column.

aligns-y.description: Cross- and main-axis alignment respectively in a column.

is-full-width.description: Opt in when the column must fill its parent.

is-full-height.description: Opt in when the column must fill its parent.

inset.description: Padding on all sides. Accepts a size keyword (2xs to 4xl), a scale step, or any CSS length.

inset-x.description: Padding on the left and right. Accepts a size keyword (2xs to 4xl), a scale step, or any CSS length.

inset-y.description: Padding on the top and bottom. Accepts a size keyword (2xs to 4xl), a scale step, or any CSS length.

does-wrap.description: Lets children wrap into additional columns when the column is height-constrained.

z-column.accessibility: Layout only. It adds no role or label and passes its content through unchanged.

z-combobox.summary: A select you can type into to filter the options.

value.description: Value of the selected option. Reflected.

label.description: Accessible name for compact contextual use. Prefer z-field for standalone comboboxes.

placeholder.description: Hint text shown while the control is empty.

options.description: The list to filter and choose from. Set it as a property.

tone.description: Accent color of the focused field and active option.

is-disabled.description: Blocks interaction, dims the element, and removes it from the keyboard focus order.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

name.description: Form field name, used when the control is submitted with a form.

description.description: Helper text shown under the control and linked to it for screen readers.

error.description: Error message shown under the control. Setting it marks the control invalid.

size.description: Control height and text size.

is-invalid.description: Marks the control invalid and shows it in the error style.

is-required.description: Marks the field as required for form validation.

change.description: Fired when an option is chosen.

keyboard.action: Filters the options and opens the list.
Open the list, then move, wrapping and skipping disabled options.
Commits the active option.
Close the list and clear the search text.

z-combobox.accessibility: role="combobox" on a native text input with aria-autocomplete, aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at a listbox. Give it a label.

guidance.title: Dismissal
guidance.text: Escape or a pointer press outside the control closes the list and clears its uncommitted query.

z-command.summary: A command palette on a native dialog, with search, groups and keyboard control.

is-open.description: Whether the element is open. Reflected, so it can be set or read from markup or script.

items.description: Commands to search and run. Set it as a property.
items.type: { value?: string; label: string; group?: string; shortcut?: string; keywords?: string[]; isDisabled?: boolean }[]

placeholder.description: Hint text shown while the control is empty.

select.description: Fired when a command is run.

slots.trigger: The element that opens the palette.
slots.footer: A footer under the list, such as key hints.
slots.empty: What to show when nothing matches.

keyboard.action: Filters the commands.
Move through the matches.
Chooses the active command, fires select, and closes.
Closes without choosing.

z-command.accessibility: A native dialog holding a labelled search input and a listbox of options. The active option is announced with aria-selected, and Escape closes it.

guidance.title: Keyboard
guidance.text: Arrow keys move through enabled results, Enter selects, and Escape closes. Keep shortcuts visible when they are meaningful.

guidance.title: Choice
guidance.text: Use for frequent commands and navigation. Do not hide the only way to discover a critical feature in the palette.

z-command-item.summary: One entry in a command palette.

label.description: Text shown for the entry. The search matches it.

is-disabled.description: Disables this entry. It is skipped by the keyboard and cannot be chosen.

value.description: Identifies this entry in the select event.

shortcut.description: Shortcut hint shown at the end of the row. It is a label only and does not bind a key.

group.description: Heading this entry is listed under.

keywords.description: Extra words the search matches besides the label.

slots.default: The row content. The label attribute is what the search matches.

z-command-item.accessibility: One option in a command palette. The palette gives it role="option" and manages selection.

z-container.summary: A centered, max-width wrapper with horizontal gutters.

size.description: Largest content width. Accepts a size keyword (`xs` to `3xl`, `full`, `screen`) or any CSS length.

gutter.description: Padding on the left and right edges, so content never touches the viewport. Accepts a size keyword or any CSS length.

is-centered.description: Declared for API completeness (centered by default).

is-full-height.description: Stretches to at least the parent's height (`min-height: 100%`).

z-container.accessibility: Layout only. It adds no role or label and passes its content through unchanged.

guidance.title: Use inside sections
guidance.text: z-section owns vertical rhythm; z-container owns horizontal rhythm.

z-context-menu.summary: A right-click menu around the element you wrap.

items.description: Rows of the menu. Set it as a property.
items.type: { value?: string; label?: string; shortcut?: string; isDisabled?: boolean; isSeparator?: boolean; isDanger?: boolean }[]

tone.description: Accent color of the highlighted item.

is-disabled.description: Turns off the right-click and long-press gesture, so the browser menu shows instead.

select.description: Fired when an item is chosen.

slots.default: The area that opens the menu.
slots.controls: Extra controls shown at the top of the menu.

keyboard.action: Opens the menu and moves focus into it.
Move through the items.
Chooses the active item.
Closes and returns focus to the target.

z-context-menu.accessibility: role="menu" opened by the contextmenu gesture, which includes the context-menu key and Shift+F10. Focus moves into the menu and returns to the target when it closes.

guidance.title: Discoverability
guidance.text: Context menus are an accelerator. Mirror important commands in a visible menu or toolbar for touch and unfamiliar users.

z-dialog.summary: A modal built on the native dialog element.

is-open.description: Whether the element is open. Reflected, so it can be set or read from markup or script.

heading.description: Title of the dialog. It is also the dialog's accessible name.

is-static.description: Stops the dialog from closing when the backdrop is clicked. Escape and the close button still work.

is-disabled.description: Prevent the trigger from opening.

label.description: Accessible name for the dialog.

close.description: Fired when the dialog closes, however it was dismissed.

slots.trigger: The element that opens the dialog.

--z-dialog-width.description: Width of the dialog. Set it on the element or an ancestor.

keyboard.action: On the trigger: opens it and moves focus inside.
Cycles inside the dialog. The page behind is inert.
Closes and returns focus to what opened it.

z-dialog.accessibility: A native dialog, so focus is trapped, the page behind is inert, and Escape closes it. Labelled by its heading, or by label when there is none. Focus returns to the trigger.

guidance.title: Slots

z-toolbar-group.summary: A labeled cluster of controls inside a toolbar.

label.description: Accessible name for grouped controls. Keep it concise and specific.

is-hidden.description: Removes the cluster from layout.

z-toolbar-group.accessibility: role="group" around related toolbar controls. Give it a label.

guidance.title: Parent
guidance.text: Use only within z-toolbar.

z-tooltip.summary: A hover and focus label anchored to its trigger.

placement.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Add `-start` or `-end` to align to an edge, for example `top-start`. The tooltip flips when there is no room.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

content.description: Tooltip text (required; no content = no tooltip).

open-delay.description: Milliseconds the pointer must rest on the trigger before the tooltip opens.

is-disabled.description: Blocks interaction, dims the element, and removes it from the keyboard focus order.

tone.description: Color of the tooltip.

does-hide-arrow.description: Hides the arrow that points at the trigger.

keyboard.action: Focusing the trigger shows the tooltip; leaving hides it.
Hides it.

z-tooltip.accessibility: role="tooltip", shown on hover and on focus and hidden by Escape. Its text is forwarded to the trigger as its description. Put essential information in the page, not only in a tooltip.

guidance.title: Accessibility
guidance.text: It opens on focus as well as hover, but it cannot replace an accessible name on an icon-only button.

z-tree.summary: A hierarchical tree with expand, collapse, selection and keyboard navigation.

is-hidden.description: Hides the element with display: none. It stays in the DOM and keeps its state.

items.description: Nodes of the tree. Children nest under `children`. Set it as a property.

selection.description: How many nodes can be selected.

selected.description: Ids of the selected nodes. Set it as a property.

expanded.description: Ids of the expanded nodes. Set it as a property.

does-show-guides.description: Draws vertical guide lines for each level of nesting.

activate.description: Fired when a node is activated with Enter or a double-click.

keyboard.action: Move to the next or previous visible row.
First and last visible row.
Expands a closed branch.
Collapses an open branch.
Activates the focused row and fires activate.

z-tree.accessibility: role="tree" with role="treeitem" rows carrying aria-level, aria-selected and aria-expanded. Arrow keys, Home and End move, Right expands and Left collapses.
